events.label: July PPI (BLS, 8:30 AM ET) — inflation follow-on to CPI
events.note: Updated Aug 12 night: July CPI delivered 3.4% headline (in-line) / 2.5% core (below soft threshold); September hike odds fell from ~50% to ~38–40% (CME FedWatch: 62% hold). The 30Y held flat at ~5.25% — did not compress on the core surprise. PPI's energy component is the primary watch item: WTI held $82–83 through July, embedding a cost that the CPI core measure did not surface. Hot PPI energy line re-anchors September odds above 40% and blocks the 30Y compression path toward 5.10%. CSCO −4% AH creates a morning headwind for enterprise networking names. 30Y direction post-PPI: below 5.15% = first de-escalation signal entering Jackson Hole; above 5.28% = rate overhang re-entrenches entering the NVDA setup window.

events.label: SPCX next staggered tranche (~7%) — second unlock after Aug 6 first tranche
events.note: Updated Aug 10 morning: Day 5 (Aug 10) closed $133.11, up 15.83% from Day 3's $114.92 — 20% first tranche absorbed above the $105 floor. Terafab Texas AI compute megafactory (SpaceX + Tesla JV, $16.8B, announced Aug 8) provided the incremental catalyst. Next staggered tranche (~7%, ~65M shares, ~$8.65B eligible) expected around Aug 20. Absorption thesis: close above $128 through CPI (Aug 12). Front-run signal: close below $115 on elevated volume before Aug 20 means the next tranche is being pre-sold. CPI Wednesday is the binary: soft → rate compression extends absorption window; hot → simultaneous multiple compression and supply pressure. Morgan Stanley $140, Bernstein $248, Citi $200 targets; 28 of 30 analysts Buy. October Q3 earnings (Starlink profitability, AI segment above $2.56B) is the narrative anchor.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — CSCO beat-and-sell AH template raises the bar at altitude
events.note: Updated Aug 12 night: NVDA settled $223.40 after CPI day (+$225.10 intraday high; $216 structural support intact). CSCO Q4 FY2026 beat-and-raise ($17.3B revenue, EPS $1.22, FY27 guidance $72.2–73.4B) still drew −4% AH, establishing the 'good news already priced' ceiling for AI infrastructure names. CRWV's $104B backlog and CPI's 2.5% core are the best available macro and demand evidence heading into the print. Three active regime conditions: 30Y ~5.25% (13th session above 5.00%), WTI $83.09 (above $79), Brent above $85. Q2 FY27 call watch: (1) Gross margin above 76% — minimum bar; meeting it alone may not expand the multiple per the CSCO template. (2) Q3 guide above consensus — required at $223.40. Jackson Hole keynote Aug 27 begins one day after earnings — no de-risk window. Level that changes the setup read positively: NVDA AH holds $225+ AND 30Y closes below 5.15% in the two sessions before Aug 26.

events.label: Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium (Aug 27–29) — Warsh keynote after NFP + CPI + PPI
events.note: Updated Aug 12 night: September hike odds at ~38–40% (CME FedWatch: 62% hold) after July CPI core 2.5% — furthest below 70% trigger since before the July 31 ECI spike. July PPI (Aug 13) is the intervening data point before Jackson Hole. At 38–40%, 'live meeting' language would be a shock; 'data-dependent, watching oil and labor' is the base path. NFP removed the wage-inflation channel; CPI core surprised soft; PPI determines whether supply-inflation persists. 30Y held flat at ~5.25% despite the core surprise — the bond market's prior reading persists. NVDA earnings land Aug 26 — one day before the keynote, with no de-risk window. If September odds hold above 35% through Aug 26, the macro overhang compounds altitude risk for the NVDA print.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — terminal insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut. Lock-up expiries are the known supply overhang for hot IPOs. Context after Aug 6-7: 20% first tranche absorbed at $105-$115; next tranches scheduled Aug 20 and late September. Q3 Starlink profitability (~October call) is the only fundamental catalyst that could revalue the lockup discount before the December terminal release. SPCX Q2: $18.37B capex vs $7.81B revenue; AI segment $2.56B (+247% YoY).

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). PLTR's 149% US commercial growth, AMD's $6.7B data-center (+107%), and SpaceX's exclusive Nvidia commitment ($15.83B AI capex) confirm the enterprise AI adoption underlying OpenAI's revenue model. NVDA circular financing disclosure ($250B OpenAI backstop) remains the unresolved structural question that may surface in S-1 filings.
